summary: Database-only groundwork for price lists (new tables, enums, nullable pricelist_id on accounts, parentId on categories). Migration file begins with two lines of pnpm output, so it is invalid SQL and fails when applied.

statements.text: 1 problem: migration.sql starts with "Already up to date", terminal output not SQL; applying it will fail.
statements.why: migration.sql lines 1-2 are pnpm output; migrate deploy fails.

statements.text: Your database now stores crm price lists ... can have many crm price list rules, crm price list rules and crm accounts.
statements.why: Matches crm_PriceLists; duplicated 'rules' wording is clumsy but true.

statements.text: Your database now stores crm price list rules ... belongs to a crm price lists, a crm price lists, a crm product categories and a crm products.
Crm accounts are now linked to crm price lists.
Currencies are now linked to crm price lists.
Crm product categories are now linked to crm product categories, crm product categories and crm price list rules.
Crm products are now linked to crm price list rules.
Apply prisma/migrations/20261011000000_price_lists to your live database before the new code goes live, or pages that load crm accounts and categories can fail.
statements.why: Correct; the card also tells the owner to fix the invalid SQL lines first in the problem box.

misses.what: Nothing visible changes for users yet; database structure only.
